CafeConfig.title: CafeConfig
CafeConfig.description: Shared cafe workspace configuration including role PINs, 78->79 alias toggle, staff list, and daily ticket sequence counter.

cashierPin.description: 4 to 8 digit PIN locking the Cashier view.

ticketerPin.description: 4 to 8 digit PIN locking the Ticketer view.

pinsCustomized.description: Whether the user has customized the initial default PINs.

alias78To79.description: When true, entering menu code 78 maps to the item configured at 79.

staff.description: Ordered list of waiter/staff names selectable when sending a ticket.

nextTicketSeq.description: Next sequential ticket number for the current day.

lastTicketDay.description: YYYY-MM-DD key for the last issued ticket number.

dayEpoch.description: Resettable daily session epoch incremented on Start New Day while preserving prior history.

linkedEmail.description: Verified Gmail address linked to the cafe workspace.

appPasswordHash.description: Salted PBKDF2 hash of the dedicated workspace App Password.

appPasswordSalt.description: Random hex salt paired with appPasswordHash.

appPasswordSet.description: True when the cafe workspace has an active App Password.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when config was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) of last config update.

MenuItem.title: MenuItem
MenuItem.description: Cafe menu item mapped to a numeric code from 1 to 1000.

name.description: Amharic or English display name of the menu item.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when menu item was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) of last menu item update.

CafeOrder.title: CafeOrder
CafeOrder.description: Minimal low-bandwidth order ticket dispatched from Cashier to Ticketer.

dayKey.description: Local date string YYYY-MM-DD for fast daily filtering.

dayEpoch.description: Active day session epoch when the order was created.

items.description: Compact list of line item maps {c, n, q, p} with snapshotted price p.

totalAmount.description: Total ticket price in ETB based on snapshotted item prices.

unpaid.description: True when the order was sent as unpaid (ያልተከፈለ) until marked paid (ተከፍሏል).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when ticket was sent.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) of last state update.

completedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when completed or returned.

paidAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when an unpaid order is marked paid.

/users/{userId}/config/{configId}.description: Workspace settings document (settings) owned by the signed-in Google account.

/users/{userId}/menuItems/{codeId}.description: Numeric menu items (1-1000) owned by the signed-in Google account.

/users/{userId}/orders/{orderId}.description: Real-time cafe order tickets shared between Cashier and Ticketer.
